steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following with only one Button:
1. When no Button is pressed, do nothing
2. When the Button is pressed and held, make a beeping tone continously
3. When the Button is released, no sound will be played immediately
 Hint: 1. The beeping must stop when the Button is released

Show that your robot can perform the following with only one Button:
1. When no Button is pressed, do nothing
2. When the Button is pressed twice, play a sound
3. When the Button is released, no sound will be played immediately

Hint:
1. The beeping must stop when the Button is released

Show that your robot can perform the following with only one Button:
1. When no Button is pressed, do nothing

2. When the Button is pressed twice and held, make a beeping tone continuously

3. When the Button is released, no sound will be played immediately

Hint:
1. The sound must stop when the Button is released

Show that your robot can perform the following with only one Button:

1. When no Button is pressed, do nothing.

2. When the Button is pressed and held, play a buzzer tone continuously

3. When the Button is pressed twice and hold, make a beeping sound continuously.

4. When the Button is released, no sound will be played immediately


Hint:

1. The sound must stop when the Button is released
